interpretation.objective: Support translational research at the interface of fundamental plasma science and technological innovation: proposals must articulate a fundamental scientific/engineering challenge in plasma science and engineering (spanning plasma physics, chemistry, materials science, and space science) that is relevant across multiple NSF programs, and substantively explain how resolving that challenge addresses specific societal or technological needs (e.g., manufacturing, energy, sensing, computational modeling, chemical measurement, or plasmonics applications).
